Modify plot theme (aligns with ggplot2::theme)

Source: R/style.R
style.Rd

Applies plotit's default theme and overrides individual elements via .... Call style(p) without arguments to apply the default theme, or pass theme-element overrides like style(p, plot.title = element_text(face="bold")). Use base_theme to switch to an entirely different base theme (e.g., style(p, base_theme = ggplot2::theme_bw())).

Usage

style(plot, ..., base_size = NULL, base_family = NULL, base_theme = NULL)

Arguments

plot

A plotit object.

...

Theme element overrides, passed to ggplot2::theme().

base_size

Base font size in pts (default 10).

base_family

Base font family (default "" = system sans-serif).

base_theme

A complete ggplot2 theme object to use instead of the default (e.g., ggplot2::theme_bw()). NULL = use plotit default.

Value

Modified plotit object.

Examples

plotit(iris, encode(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length)) |>
  mark_point() |>
  style()
